notes:
## New features & enhancements

- **A mini radio that stays on top.** The pushpin in the top bar opens a small strip that floats above every other window: station, what it is doing, play, volume, a meter and a clock.
- The radio's own window tucks out of sight behind the strip while it is pinned, and comes back when you expand.
- The strip counts the last thirty seconds down before a schedule change and says which of the three things is about to happen; its fader rides the handover fade the same way the radio's own does.
- Double-clicking the strip's fader slides it back to 50.
- On Windows the strip opens at the right size and cannot be dragged to another one. That is `strip-fit.ps1`, the only thing this project leaves running — it stops when the radio's window goes.
- Chrome, Edge and Firefox 151 or newer. Where a browser has no such window the pushpin is not shown at all.

## Bug fixes

- A remembered window size that was too **big** was never corrected, and nothing else could undo it: the box is written on a timer whether or not the window was ever fitted, so a launch that never got that far wrote its own wrong size down and every launch after restored it. Measured at 279px of dead space, permanently.
- The wanted window size was worked out in two places that asked different questions, which is how a window left too big satisfied one and was never handed to the other. One piece of arithmetic now.
